notes: Diagnosed and fixed ReferenceError: _bsTouchStart is not defined on page load. Initial hypothesis (ES module caching) was wrong — hard refresh did not resolve it. Used playwright-cli headed browser to diagnose: Vue 3 emitted warning 'Property _bsTouchStart should not start with _ which is a reserved prefix for Vue internals' followed by ReferenceError during render. Root cause: Vue 3 reserves _-prefixed properties for Vue internals and refuses to resolve them in template expressions. Fix: renamed _bsTouchStart/_bsTouchEnd/_bsTouchCancel to bsTouchStart/bsTouchEnd/bsTouchCancel, and internal state properties _bsTouchStartY/_bsTouchStartScrollTop to bsTouchStartY/bsTouchStartScrollTop across createCollageMethods.js, index.html, and BottomSheetTest.html. Added JSDoc comment documenting the naming constraint. All 1482 unit tests pass with 0 failures. Page renders correctly verified via playwright-cli screenshot.
